scoring_justification: Recomputing the EFT-2 solver in the checker sandbox is infeasible; instead agent's reported tricritical coordinates and w* are compared to paper-derived reference values with tolerances, and mandatory trends are verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference tricritical point coordinates and w* value derived from paper Fig.1 / Fig.3 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.1 and Fig.3; isotropic SC tricritical point explicitly given as (2.274,2.748); other values estimated from the figure.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized approximate coordinates from Fig.1(a,b) for SC and BCC at r_y=1.5,2.0; w* estimated from Fig.3(a) at r_y=1.0, r_x=1.0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are extracted from published figure data, not invented, and serve as reference truth; tolerances account for reading approximation.

outputs.description: Tricritical point coordinates (H0/J, kBTc/J) for bimodal random field distribution on SC and BCC lattices for r_y=1.0,1.5,2.0.
Critical trimodal parameter w* on SC lattice at r_x=1.0, r_y=1.0.
